title: Launch HN: Versine (YC F26) – MCP to send and receive money
summary: Hey HN, we’re Harshith, Param, and Vishnu and we're building Versine ( https://versine.com ). Versine lets you send and request money just by talking or texting with your AI (think Venmo with an MCP). We’re software engineers who have worked on distributed systems at Stripe, Databricks, and Amazon. Versine is an MCP that sits in front of a wallet with a balance. With it, your agent can do things like: - Send money to someone with your approval (via passkey in our app) - Send and request money to/from up to 100 people at once - Send money to people without a Versine account (they cash out to their bank in 2 mins) - Pay people without your explicit approval to trusted contacts (you can set this) Here’s a demo:  https://youtube.com/shorts/Q9X7zioEqi0  We started working on this because assistants are frustratingly hands-off when it comes to finance and money movement.
